datasets.title: Inspiration4 Blood Serum Biomarker Reference Ranges
datasets.description: Pre-flight vs post-flight deltas for blood serum cytokines and cardiac markers from the SpaceX Inspiration4 mission (3-day LEO).

IL6_pg_ml.name: Interleukin-6 (IL-6)
IL6_pg_ml.notes: Acute inflammatory marker; elevated post-flight due to fluid shifts and immune activation.

TNFalpha_pg_ml.name: Tumor Necrosis Factor-alpha (TNF-α)
TNFalpha_pg_ml.notes: Pro-inflammatory cytokine; increases correlate with spaceflight duration.

CRP_mg_L.name: C-Reactive Protein (CRP)
CRP_mg_L.notes: Systemic inflammation marker; sensitive to re-entry stress.

Troponin_I_ng_L.name: Cardiac Troponin I
Troponin_I_ng_L.notes: Cardiac biomarker; transient elevation may indicate myocardial stress from fluid redistribution.

BNP_pg_ml.name: B-type Natriuretic Peptide (BNP)
BNP_pg_ml.notes: Ventricular stretch marker; elevated due to cephalad fluid shift in microgravity.

datasets.title: Inspiration4 Urine Inflammation Panel
datasets.description: Urine cytokine and chemokine panel comparing normal Earth ranges with spaceflight-shifted values from the Inspiration4 mission.

MCP1_pg_ml.name: Monocyte Chemoattractant Protein-1 (MCP-1/CCL2)
MCP1_pg_ml.notes: Chemokine driving monocyte recruitment; urinary elevation reflects systemic immune activation.

IL8_pg_ml.name: Interleukin-8 (IL-8/CXCL8)
IL8_pg_ml.notes: Neutrophil chemoattractant; urinary levels elevated correlating with renal stress.

VEGF_pg_ml.name: Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor (VEGF)
VEGF_pg_ml.notes: Angiogenic factor; elevated in response to endothelial shear stress changes.

IP10_pg_ml.name: Interferon gamma-induced Protein 10 (IP-10/CXCL10)
IP10_pg_ml.notes: Th1 chemokine marker; indicator of interferon-driven immune response.

IL1beta_pg_ml.name: Interleukin-1 beta (IL-1β)
IL1beta_pg_ml.notes: Pyrogenic cytokine; urinary elevation suggests inflammasome activation.

datasets.title: Whole-Blood Gene Expression Markers During Spaceflight
datasets.description: Key genes showing significant differential expression in astronaut whole-blood samples during ISS missions.

upregulated_genes.function: Neutrophil chemotaxis and acute inflammatory signaling
Damage-associated molecular pattern (DAMP); innate immune activation
Alpha-defensin; antimicrobial peptide reflecting immune priming
Matrix metalloproteinase; tissue remodeling and extracellular matrix degradation

downregulated_genes.function: T-cell receptor complex component; adaptive immunity
IL-7 receptor; critical for T-cell homeostasis and survival
Granzyme B; cytotoxic T-cell and NK-cell killing
Chemokine receptor guiding lymphocyte homing to lymph nodes
T-cell factor; transcription factor for T-cell differentiation
